note: Exact wording from the design (Notes and Copy). Words the design avoids: AI-powered, smart, magic, scores as percentages, wrong, correct, better. Strings with numbers are samples; fill them from real values at build time.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Hover raises the gradient 8%. Press inverts it for 40 ms. Enter or Space activates. Focus shows a 2 px accent ring.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: Dimmed to 70%. Hover shows a tooltip that says why, for example “Select a range first”.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Click flips on and off. The on state adds a check and a fill, so it is not colour only. Mixed shows a dash.
Space plays and stops. Return goes to start. Clicking record while armed starts recording and the button turns solid red with the word “Recording”.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: Record is off with “Choose an input first” when no track is armed.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: R arms, I monitors, M mutes, S solos. Option-click on S sets solo-safe (outline). Another solo shows other tracks as dashed “implicitly muted”.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: On an inactive track all four are off and say “Track is inactive”.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Drag to change. Shift-drag is fine adjust. Double-click resets to 0 dB. While dragging a tooltip shows the value. Arrow keys move 0.1 dB, Shift 1 dB.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: When automation is in Read the cap is outlined and moves by itself. Dragging then asks to switch to Touch.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Drag up or down. Double-click centres. Arrow keys move one step.
Click the clip box to clear the latched clip. Hover shows peak and RMS in dB.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: A track that is off shows an empty well with no fill.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Click selects with a 2 px outline. Drag moves. Drag an edge to trim. Hover near the top corners shows fade handles. Double-click opens the clip in the editor.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: Locked clips show a dashed outline and refuse drag with the message “Clip is locked”. Missing media shows “Relink…”.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Click to edit. Enter confirms. Escape cancels. Tab switches between Bars|Beats and Min:Secs.
Click sets the playhead. Drag selects a range. The Ruler button in the corner collapses it to one row.
Click selects and shows it in the inspector. Double-click the name to rename. Drag the bottom edge to change the height.
Click the power dot to bypass. Click the name to open. Drag to reorder. Empty slots open a plug-in list.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: Bypassed shows a struck-through name and the word “Bypassed”.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Drag on the waveform to select a range. Handles move one edge. The readout shows start, end and length. Choose a target note and “Use current selection” to set a practice region.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: With no range it shows “Select a range on the lead vocal to see its pitch.” Practice results appear only for a chosen region.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Hover shows “Nearest note to the measured pitch. This is not a grade.” Tags are not clickable.
Enter sends. Shift-Enter adds a line. Evidence links move the playhead and highlight the range they refer to. Cancel stops work and changes nothing.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: When the cloud assistant is off the request box is off and says why. Goal chips still work.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Editing any value turns the preview stale and enables Render. Approve is off while the preview is out of date. Reject needs no confirmation.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: Approve is off with the message “Render the preview first” when the preview is stale.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Space switches A and B. The order is random for each audition. Loudness matching affects listening only. Keep this change, Keep the original and Discard have equal size and weight.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: When the session changes, Keep this change turns off and the strip says why. The other two stay on.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: Click a row to open its receipt. Undo is available only for Applied tasks. Recovery required offers three actions with the evidence beside them.
interaction_notes.disabled_or_unavailable: Undo reads “Not needed” or “Not available” instead of a blank.

interaction_notes.click_hover_keyboard: The status bar is always visible while recording. Details opens the take list. The disk-full dialog takes focus and needs a click to close.
